title: Flows on big photos: every Flow screen draws a display copy, and no export builds a source-size canvas
description: 2.0 BREAKER (Fabio 2026-10-04, his pre-cut smoke): a 32K photo shows a broken chip in a Flow's Inputs slot and a 16K paints in step by step; Draw It In's paint step is unusable on a 16K. MPI-961/971 gave the History canvas and the engine big-photo handling; the Flow image loader and step screens (MpiMediaPicker, MpiStepBox/Preview/Crop/Paint/Cutout/Place) never got it. Fabio: implement if easy, else gate with a warning. Folded under the MPI-595 umbrella.
